notes.title: Deluded v0.4 Closed Beta Changelog
notes.notes:
[b]4th day of the prologue is now available![/b] 🎉

[previewyoutube=uX3GJofUY1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

You've been waiting patiently, we've been working like crazy. And yes, there’s [i]a lot[/i] to unpack. More quests, new characters, NPC schedule and more.


Now, let’s see what our team has been sweating over…

NPC system, being the flagship of this update, was a pretty big bite to chew, but we nailed it! All the previous systems we worked on (see the [url=https://i.imgur.com/gCgcJXY.png]roadmap[/url]) were tied to the main character, whereas NPC system involves not only that, but also complex interactions with the characters and the whole game world! That's why it took us more than anticipated. NPCs now not only go about their various routines and move between locations, but they are also able to adjust their dialogues with the MC based on the current event, open/close doors and interact with items and objects around. The only downside is that you can't yet talk to NPCs while they're walking, but we'll make sure to add this into the next minor updates. 

One of the biggest additions in v0.4 is a fully [i]fleshed-out[/i] new gloor scene. The tags of the gloor vial speak for themselves—and yes, it’s not for the faint of heart (you can check the tags by hovering over the gloor vial in the game). Took us about half a year and the efforts of 4 people to make it all for your enjoyment (all the 113 sequences and 236 animations!). The team highlights just how many [b]branching paths and fetish/attribute combinations[/b] went into this scene—and how cohesive it turned out in the end! We also got to experiment with camera angles, lighting and movement… And honestly? If we’re this pleased with how it turned out, you’re probably in for a good time too.

And what about the core mechanics and gameplay systems? Apart from the already mentioned NPC system, you can also spot early drafts of the Privacy system (private/semi-private/public areas, [b]Shame[/b] as a new attribute affecting [b]Stress[/b]) and Character customization mechanics (nails, pills that alter some aspects of Alisa’s appearance) here and there. 

And rest assured: work on open world is in full swing, and you can already mess with it yourself! Go to Lindcliff → use [b]the Orb[/b] in your inventory → click [b]Start open world[/b] or [b]Use[/b]. It’s filled with prototypes, so don’t expect full-on gameplay.

Lastly, would you look at this monstrous changelog! Because of how much new and complex stuff there is, [b]we need your testing and feedback now more than ever![/b]

Enjoy!

notes.title: (April Fools) Big changes are coming to Deluded!
notes.notes:
[b]You’ve had your fair share of posts regarding the v0.4 updates,[/b] and today it’s time for yet another one! This time, however, we’re not just talking new content—we’re talking [b]a fundamental shift in core mechanics.[/b]

After deep reflection and having endured waves of negativity and relentless critique, we have decided to [b]remove all explicit content.[/b] We know this won’t please everyone, but we believe this shift will help us reach the players who are actually looking for something deeper—something that resonates on a different level. It also became clear that an adult-focused project simply won’t sustain itself in the way we hoped, so we have to change things up. We're choosing a different direction—a redemptive one. Moving forward, [b]50% of all proceeds[/b] will go to the reconstruction of churches around the world—a small step toward something more meaningful.

These are just a few of the adjustments we’re ready to announce—more to come.

[h3][b]Content changes[/b][/h3]

[list]
    [*][b]Scandalously revealing outfits[/b] will be replaced by modest attire
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/20da05a823c4d9c031f184b2a3c44d191d9689f5.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][b]Lewd animations[/b] will be replaced with meditation and humble prayers
    [*][b]Characters' bedrooms[/b] will be redecorated into modest cells, free from temptations, furnished exclusively with wooden benches and inspirational spiritual texts
    [*]To foster purity, [b]all alcoholic beverages[/b] in-game will be replaced with blessed herbal teas
    [*]NPCs will be [b]unable to flirt or express carnal intent[/b]; instead, they will offer proverbs, reflections or hymns
    [*]Added [b]Righteous Tremble effect:[/b] hovering over leftover lewd items from earlier builds causes a soft UI tremor, paired with Alisa’s uneasy breath and a faint, disapproving chime
[/list]

[h3][b]New quests[/b][/h3]

[list]
    [*][i]“Fast Until Nightfall”.[/i] Alisa must abstain from all food and drink for a full in-game day
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554424/aebff3a8abac3d626d575b3a3f6e9fd8bf982d76.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][i]“Chastity Outreach”.[/i] Visit three flirtatious NPCs and politely convince them to reconsider their life choices
[/list]

[h3][b]Attribute Adjustments[/b][/h3]

[list]
    [*][b]LEWD and PURE are now merged into CHASTE.[/b] You gain Chaste points by remaining fully clothed in private spaces and spending extended periods in solitude or reflection. Chaste is passively increased while staying near holy objects
    [*][b]SUB is now DEVOTED HUMILITY.[/b] Increases when Alisa accepts commands, avoids confrontation, or apologizes unnecessarily
    [*][b]DOM is now RESPECTFUL LEADERSHIP.[/b] Gained by taking initiative in virtuous ways, resolving conflict peacefully, or guiding others with dignity
[/list]

We’ll continue to keep you updated on any further adjustments as we courageously embark on this wholesome and righteous path. May purity light our way!

[h1][b][i]SIKE[/i] 😏[/b][/h1]
